items.title: AmTrust acquires Wakam weeks after French regulator halted underwriting
items.summary: Insurance Business reports that AmTrust International has acquired pan-European B2B2C insurer Wakam less than five weeks after French regulators suspended its underwriting.

items.title: Kinsale posts strong Q3 combined ratio despite net income decline
items.summary: Reinsurance News reports that Kinsale Capital Group recorded a strong third-quarter combined ratio of 75.4% for 2026, even as net income fell by roughly 30%.

items.title: OAK Global bolsters Lloyd’s platform with senior risk and underwriting appointments
items.summary: Reinsurance News reports that OAK Global has strengthened its leadership team with the promotion of Fraser Scott and the appointment of John Coe.

items.title: Bank of England flags insurance gaps as a systemic economic concern
items.summary: Insurance Business reporting highlights that widening protection gaps and physical climate risks could threaten broader financial stability, according to a senior Bank of England official.

items.title: PIC completes £85m buy-in for Interface Europe Pension Scheme
items.summary: Reinsurance News reports that Pension Insurance Corporation has completed an £85 million buy-in covering over a thousand members of the Interface Europe Pension Scheme.

items.title: Commonwealth University Introduces Risk Management and Insurance Curriculum
items.summary: Insurance Journal reports that Pennsylvania’s Commonwealth University has launched new academic offerings in risk management and insurance.
